evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never framed the call duration, the value of a dependable quote, or asked for customer confirmation before proceeding.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asked 'What are your biggest concerns about this move?' — jumped straight into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (2-story, 900 sqft; 1-story 1400 sqft), bedrooms (2, one as office), garage items (deep freeze), driveway access (yes at both), special items (solid wood furniture, no antiques/fragile items), box count (20-30 boxes, customer confirmed).
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not asked — rep never offered 'Would you like us to pack your items into boxes for you?'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes — 'typically for a home this size we would usually see about twenty to thirty boxes. Do you fall within that range?' Customer confirmed yes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gave time estimate (3 hours + 1 hour buffer) and hourly rate structure (2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments), but did not personalize to this customer's move or state a dollar range.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep disclosed 2.5-hour minimum and 15-minute increment structure. Did not disclose trip fee, overnight fee, or packing materials upfront; did not frame as 'not a guess.'
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asked 'Does that feel fair?' or held silence for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asked 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or 'Any questions?' at the end.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Call ended with 'thank you for your time' and goodbyes without any booking ask.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: No booking details confirmed — no date (already on file from online booking), phone re-confirmed, no arrival window review, crew size, addresses (already on file), or crew notes about customer concerns.

top_strength: Therese gathered comprehensive logistics details efficiently — property specs, bedroom count, garage items, access, special considerations, appliances, and box count — building a clear picture of the move scope.
coaching_note: This call skipped the entire heart of the sales process: Therese never asked 'What are your biggest concerns?', never delivered the Two Promises, never held silence after pricing, and never asked for the business — she treated it as an admin intake instead of a consultative quote call.
